categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in research, development, production and sales of specialty formulated modified epoxy resin series products. Main product lines include wind turbine blade epoxy resins, novel composite material epoxy resins, and electronic/electrical insulation encapsulation epoxy resins. The company also produces small quantities of quantum dot-related products. Products are applied across wind energy, electronics, transportation, high-pressure gas cylinders, petrochemicals, sports equipment, and display screen industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses deep technical formula accumulation and proprietary production processes for specialty formulated modified epoxy resins. Core technologies include unique material composition optimization, precise ratio determination of raw materials, and process parameter control under different equipment conditions. The company has developed complete R&D systems with 73 research personnel, holds 25 invention patents and 68 utility model patents. Production methods include vacuum infusion, hand lay-up, and RTM (Resin Transfer Molding) processes adapted to different application requirements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are major wind turbine manufacturers, composite material producers, and electronics manufacturers. Key end markets include: wind energy (81.45% of 2023 revenue), novel composite materials (12.80% of revenue), and electronic/electrical insulation encapsulation (5.50% of revenue). The company serves customers in wind power generation, rail transit, automotive lightweighting, high-pressure gas cylinders, LED packaging, and display screen applications. Top 5 customers account for 80.38% of annual sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Shanghai's Jiading District. Operating subsidiaries are located in Shanghai, Guangzhou, Taicang (Jiangsu), Foshan (Guangdong), Shanwei (Guangdong), and Zhuhai (Guangdong). Domestic sales represent 99.88% of revenue. The company has minimal international operations with exports representing only 0.12% of 2023 revenue, primarily to overseas customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It sources raw materials (primarily base epoxy resins, curing agents, and additives) from upstream suppliers, then manufactures specialty formulated epoxy resin products for direct sale to downstream composite material manufacturers, wind turbine blade producers, and electronics manufacturers. The company does not engage in upstream petrochemical production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) developing new products and expanding application fields beyond wind energy; (2) increasing market share in composite materials and electronics sectors; (3) advancing product performance in heat resistance, mechanical properties, and environmental compatibility; (4) pursuing digital transformation; (5) expanding production capacity through new manufacturing facilities in Zhuhai and Shanghai. R&D focuses on low-temperature curing resins, high-performance composites, quantum dot materials, and sustainable/recyclable resin systems.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of specialty epoxy resin products (97.41% of 2023 revenue), with minor distribution channel sales (2.59%). Revenue is recognized when products are delivered to customers at designated locations and accepted. The company operates on a make-to-order basis with sales driven by customer demand for wind turbine blades, composite materials, and electronic components. Payment terms are negotiated with individual customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading specialty epoxy resin manufacturer in China with strong brand recognition, particularly in wind turbine blade applications. It competes with other epoxy resin producers on the basis of technical formula depth, product line breadth, and professional talent. The company holds DNV•GL, UL, and SGS certifications. It serves as a qualified supplier to major wind turbine manufacturers and is recognized as a fast-developing representative enterprise in the specialty formulated epoxy resin industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized chemical materials manufacturer with 2023 revenue of RMB 1.378 billion (down 22.37% from 2022's RMB 1.775 billion). Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 57.4 million (down 10.72% from 2022). The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in October 2023, raising RMB 462.8 million in net proceeds. Total assets reached RMB 2.076 billion at year-end 2023. The company employs 305 staff members and operates multiple manufacturing facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) deep technical formula accumulation enabling customized solutions for specific applications; (2) comprehensive product portfolio addressing diverse market segments; (3) superior product quality and performance stability backed by international certifications; (4) strong R&D capability enabling rapid response to customer needs; (5) professional technical team with extensive industry experience; (6) proven track record as qualified supplier to major wind turbine manufacturers. Products emphasize mechanical performance, thermal resistance, environmental compatibility, and application-specific optimization.
